about: Per-frame levels (dBFS, 512 samples at 16 kHz) of macOS `say` clips 'Pitwall, what's my fuel?' (__00) and 'Pitwall.' (__03), 7 voices, mixed with pink noise: 3 s noise lead, 1.5 s tail. quiet = -70 dBFS noise (quiet_-20dB: the voice 20 dB quieter); snrN = noise N dB under the clip's active speech level. sp0/sp1 = clip start/end frame, onset = first speech frame. Not a recording of a driver.
